description: Shared enum-to-phrase mapping consumed by BOTH the P1 GT rules (canonical enum values) and the P4 reasoning renderer (fixed phrases). Decision ledger P4.2: one table, two consumers, so risk_factors <-> reasoning wording stays bidirectionally exact. Phrases are lowercase and must appear verbatim (case-insensitive) in the risk segment of the rendered reasoning; no other risk phrase may appear. Motion phrases are used as premodifiers ('a {motion_phrase} {category}'). Traffic lights are intentionally absent (P4.4: zero mentions).
